title: Evaluating vector and hybrid search performance
summary: Measure recall, latency, and index trade-offs; pick index types and metrics deliberately.

items: Evaluate vector index types and metrics.
Balance recall vs latency for ANN.

blocks.body: DP-800 expects you to evaluate, not just implement, search — recall/latency trade-offs and metric choice.

terms.definition: Fraction of true nearest neighbors an ANN search actually returns.
Time to return results; usually traded against recall in ANN.

blocks.body: Evaluate **index types** and **metrics** against your data. ANN parameters trade **recall** for **latency**; measure both on representative queries. For hybrid, verify RRF actually improves top-k relevance over either method alone.

tips: ANN tuning is a recall-vs-latency trade-off.
Always evaluate on representative queries, not toy inputs.

blocks.body: Choose index type/metric by measuring recall and latency on real queries; confirm hybrid beats single-method retrieval.
